supersedes: The prior enabled-policy requirement for manual capture is removed; only system-default identity remains required
behavior: Manual capture works when every automatic schedule is disabled
Manual capture keeps the automatic schedule disabled and records the selected system policy
System-default selection is independent: PATCH status with enabled=false and make_default=true
Selecting a new system default disables old scheduling and does not enable new scheduling
The policy status column explicitly describes scheduling; default selection, timer toggle and manual capture are separate actions
Concurrent default switches still invalidate stale manual selection; disabling scheduling alone does not invalidate it
Automatic Tick dispatch still requires enabled=true
Push-driven task updates and original idempotency bindings are retained
